name: TENAGA
recent: Tenaga Nasional 近期与 IOI Corporation 旗下公司及 CSP 500MW 签署合资协议，开发 500MWac 太阳能光伏及电池储能项目。同时，雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。新闻方面，公司强调加强电网以支持马来西亚经济，并有承包商获得 TNB 相关合约。
notable: TNB Renewables 与 Luminous Aspect 及 CSP 500MW 签署合资协议，开发 500MWac 太阳能光伏及 250MW/1,000MWh 电池储能项目，TRe 持股 70%。
PMW 获得 TNB 混凝土电杆供应合约延长，价值 RM64m。
Jati Tinggi 旗下单位收到 TNB 发出的合资项目中标通知书。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。
退休基金局（KWAP）在 10 月多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 18,236 百万，环比增长 6.6%，同比增长 8.3%；净利为 MYR 888.8 百万，环比下降 19.0%，同比下降 23.3%；净利率为 4.9%，低于上一季度的 6.4%。

recent_en: Tenaga Nasional recently signed a joint venture agreement with IOI Corporation's subsidiary and CSP 500MW to develop a 500MWac solar PV and battery storage project. Meanwhile, EPF and KWAP made multiple shareholding change filings between October and November. In the news, the company highlighted grid strengthening to support Malaysia's economy, and contractors received TNB-related contracts.
notable_en: TNB Renewables signed a joint venture agreement with Luminous Aspect and CSP 500MW to develop a 500MWac solar PV and 250MW/1,000MWh battery storage project, with TRe holding 70%.
PMW secured a RM64m extension for Tenaga's concrete pole supply job.
Jati Tinggi's unit received a letter of acceptance from Tenaga Nasional for a joint venture.
risks_en: EPF made multiple shareholding change filings between October and November.
KWAP made multiple shareholding change filings in October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 18,236 million, up 6.6% QoQ and 8.3% YoY; net income was MYR 888.8 million, down 19.0% QoQ and 23.3% YoY; net margin was 4.9%, lower than 6.4% in the previous quarter.
